title: Jacobs and Hopkins conclude abductions began mid-to-late 1800s
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Jacobs and Hopkins conclude abductions began mid-to-late 1800s, about mid-to-late 1800s at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he and Bud Hopkins had concluded that the abduction that the abduction phenomenon began in the mid to late 1800s

plain: Tim Alberino, a filmmaker and researcher, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that David Jacobs and Budd Hopkins, two well-known researchers of people who report being taken by aliens, reached a conclusion about when it started. According to Alberino, they decided that these abductions began in the mid to late 1800s. If true, it would give the abduction reports a starting point in history.
